# Repair Estimator — provenance-tracked property intelligence

> Every figure carries VERIFIED / USER_PROVIDED / MODELED / REQUIRES_KEY / UNAVAILABLE. Nothing is fabricated.

## Key pages
- /app — Streamlit estimator (progressive intake: address -> ballpark -> deep dive)
- /api/openapi.json — agent API (estimate_repair)
- /s/{token} — lender-ready share portal (public URL, expiring HMAC token)

## Cost methodology
Deterministic cost = BLS OEWS trade wages + BLS PPI materials + state multipliers.
USER_QUOTE rows are authoritative. Baselines labeled VERIFIED/MODELED, never quotes.

## Sources (official)
Census Geocoder + ACS, USGS Earthquake Catalog + Design Maps ASCE 7-22,
FEMA NFHL ArcGIS/WMS, BLS OEWS/PPI, CPSC recalls, Open-Meteo supplemental.
Proxies (floodzonemap.org, faultlinemap.com, Nominatim) are fallback-only.

## Agent access
Allowed: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot. MCP: repair-estimator-mcp (tools/call estimate_repair).
